title: Cut: delivery
situation: 0029 named the delivery cut: owned root, upgrade, install and uninstall at user scope, and retiring the event tap. Since then 0077 settled version skew and 0066 awaited a ruling on an older reader meeting a newer journal; both belong to this cut. The operator delegated the remaining cuts human-out-of-the-loop.
decision: One cut on feature branch feature/delivery, across delivery and the concept journal it carries: install and uninstall for one user across every project, everything placed under the owned root with the harness's surfaces only referring into it; upgrade replacing the owned root whole; version skew reported at every harness start (0077); an older runtime reading past journal entries it does not know (0109); and the event tap retired from what cratylus delivers. The architect holds both contexts and approves the examples.
consequences: Realized and judged under the workflow as it now stands: live runs fail fast (0088, 0092), held-out cases run only in judgment (0103), and guards hold only acts checked before they take effect (0106).
